question: In which of the following states is the Mamallapuram Utsav celebrated?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mamallapuram Utsav** is celebrated in the state of **Tamil Nadu**.
 
• This festival is held annually in **Mamallapuram**, a UNESCO World Heritage site known for its rich **architectural and historical significance.**
 
• The Mamallapuram Utsav showcases the **traditional art, dance, and music** of Tamil Nadu, attracting visitors from across the globe.&
